violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment
violation_type.typical_finding: CCR observed stationary equipment positioned less than six feet from the perimeter.

finding_variants.text: CCR observed stationary equipment positioned less than six feet from the perimeter.
Two stationary pieces of outdoor equipment did not have six feet of use zone space.
Two pieces of stationary outdoor playground equipment fail to meet the safety requirement of a 6-foot use zone around its perimeter.
The operation does not have 6 inches of use zone space for stationary equipment on the playground.
On the school age playground, the use zone of two stationary play structures was overlapping.     On the toddler playground, the use zone of the swings and a play structure were overlapping.
CCR observed stationary equipment positioned less than two feet from the playground entry door and less than six feet from the perimeter.
